summary: Tested Mini-CRM admin upgrade end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 24 backend pytest tests pass and all 13 frontend Playwright assertions pass. Auth, KPI stats (with store filter), demand list per category, PATCH status, PATCH ca, ca_total/reparations/panier_moyen recomputation, CSV export with BOM and ; delimiter, public form posts (status='nouveau', ca=0), and mobile responsiveness all verified.

minor.issue: create_access_token(user["email"], user["email"]) passes email as user_id. JWT payload sub == email. Not a security issue but cosmetic/inconsistent.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 251: create_access_token(user['email'], user['email']) – first arg should be a real user_id, not email. Works because token only checks 'email' claim, but is misleading.
server.py POST /quote returns plain {status,id} dict with HTTP 200; consider 201 Created for resource creation (consistent across /contact /b2b /buyback).
AdminPage.jsx: useCallback omits authHeaders/token from deps via eslint-disable. Logic is fine because token state triggers re-render, but be aware that authHeaders is recomputed each render.
AdminPage.jsx CA input uses type='number' with min=0 step=1 but allows fractional via parseFloat – acceptable; but no validation feedback if user types negative or non-numeric (browser handles).
seed_data_creation: Created 5 TEST_-prefixed demands across devis/contact/entreprise/rachat collections via public POST endpoints and 1 dedicated TEST_Patch devis demand for PATCH tests. PATCH test fixture restored CA to 0 and status to 'nouveau' after asserting stats deltas, so KPIs are clean. Test demands are tagged with TEST_ prefix in name/brand/company fields for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_crm.py covers: auth (login success/fail/missing token), stats shape + store filter, list/PATCH status/PATCH ca/CSV export per category (devis/contact/entreprise/rachat), invalid category 400, unknown id 404, repare+ca=89 stats delta then restore. CSV export verified BOM (\xef\xbb\xbf), ;-delimiter, status & ca columns. Frontend Playwright covered: login, KPI 4 cards, store filter (10 options inc. Tous les magasins), tab switching, status select (5 options), Réparé reveals CA input, CA hidden when not Réparé, CSV download via expect_download (filename: repairandco_devis_YYYY-MM-DD.csv), logout, mobile 375px (KPI 2-col grid, no horizontal overflow). 5 demand cards exist post-test (TEST_ prefixed). Some legitimate accent colors (blue/yellow/purple/red) are used in status badges only — not brand UI — per instructions.
